snippet.title: Madman's Dice Steam Trailer Ft. Voyeur Motel
snippet.description:
This is the first trailer for Madman's Dice; a new RPG Maker horror game coming this Halloween!

Wishlist Madman's Dice to keep updated and get it day one! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3954610/Madmans_Dice/

You should check out my Twitter and Bluesky! If you want updates or just want to see what I'm up to, come check me out here! 
Twitter: https://x.com/OfficerDaMickey
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/officerdamickey.bsky.social

Make sure to check out the band who wrote the song featured in this trailer! You can find them on Spotify and YouTube!
Voyeur Motel Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/0mmiBJR98GjuP9gvyrj9VQ
Voyeur Motel YouTube: @voyeurmotel3049
